cover: Raids blamed on ADF kill dozens

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: An ambush on the Ukhrul road
bullets: Gunmen fired on two vehicles near New Haven.
Two of the four dead were women.
Police say the attackers are unidentified.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: A drone strike on the displaced
bullets: It hit people fleeing towards Damazin on Tuesday.
Six were wounded; some are still missing.
The governor blames the RSF, which has not commented.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Raids on Ituri villages
bullets: Attacks on 10–12 November are blamed on the ADF.
14 people are missing, local officials say.
Officials say military operations are under way.

stories.label: India · Land & livelihood
stories.head: Homes cleared on grazing land
bullets: Residents displaced by 1983 riots say they were settled there.
Residents allege they were singled out.
Officials say illegal building on such land won't be tolerated.
